connect.title: Kube ki LinkedIn
connect.intro: Dony ki akaunt me LinkedIn ma loyo ads ni. Leadrat kwano ad accounts ni keken, Lead Gen Form leads ki ad statistics, ki cwalo lok ma i keto i tic.
connect.need1: Tic mo i kom ad account me LinkedIn (Lanen onyo ma malo).
connect.need2: Tic i pot karatac me kampuni ma ki keto (Latela, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Lagwok nyo Lakwan) - LinkedIn mito ni omyero ki poko dano.
connect.need3: Lapeny me namba cim i Lead Gen Forms ni - dano ma pe ki namba cim pe kitwero medo gi.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Wac bot LinkedIn anga i kin lutela ne ma odoko dano ma ki geno. Ka ngat ma tye ka wilo jami LinkedIn oo i rwom ma iyero piny kany, Leadrat miyo ripot bot LinkedIn , wek ripot me yub ni onyut rwom pa dano ma iyero ki LinkedIn twero nongo dano mapol ma calo dano ma iyero maber loyo. LinkedIn lead ID ki one-way hash me email keken aye ki cwalo.
